description: Change your resident's own house, one action at a time: roof (its type, pitch or overhang), floor (a room's floor: a material, a colour), window_box (on one side, with flower colours), storey (one more on top), room (wall one off on a floor above), lights (string lights along the front), plant (one plant in the garden), flag (stand the flagpole on a roof's ridge), paint (a part, room, roof side or thing, in a shade or design; or like a neighbour's, and they hear that yours follows theirs), part (build a part from the kit, over real hours), porch (along the front), chimney (through the roof; with a pipes field, its stove pipes). Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. Most are free. A storey past the second, a plant to buy or grow, or a part, says what it costs or takes and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed to that in this chat. It never spends glow, and no action takes anything away. Anyone who visits sees the house.

action.description: What to do: roof, floor, window_box, storey, room, lights, plant, flag, paint, part, porch or chimney.

colour.description: floor: a colour from the paint box, like oak or sage, or a #hex.

colours.description: window_box: up to four flower colours, like ["rose", "mustard"].

confirm.description: Optional, storey, plant and part: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to the cost a call without it said.

design.description: paint, instead of shade: one of the resident's own pixel designs, by name, painted on the roof (a side), the rooftop, the siding, upper, base, gable or foundation (a face), the door, or a room's walls or floor (what: kitchen floor). plain takes one off. Free; up to 12 on a house.

face.description: Optional, paint: one side of the roof (a gable has two, a hip four; mass names one part's roof, else every roof with that side), or one face of the siding, upper, base, gable or foundation, for a design. Left out, the whole roof in a shade, or a design at the front.

level.description: Optional, room: which floor above. Left out, upstairs.

like.description: paint, instead of shade: a neighbour's name, to paint it the way theirs is. They hear that yours follows theirs.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

mass.description: Optional, roof and flag: which part of the house, like main (house names them). Left out, the main part, or for a flag the highest ridge.

name.description: room: what the new room is called.

offset.description: Optional, flag: metres along the ridge from its middle, like 0.5.

on.description: Optional, roof, floor, window_box, storey, room, lights, paint, porch and chimney: home, the resident's house (as when left out), or plot_building, the one building on its plot on the Commons (a pavilion, tea house, studio or little shop), changed the same way, under the same rules and from the same kit, and still what it was built as.

overhang.description: roof: how far the eaves reach past the walls, like 0.6.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

part.description: part: a house part from the kit, by its name or id, like turned porch posts (check kit lists them).

pipe_colour.description: Optional, chimney: instead, the stove pipes' colour, from the paint box or a #hex, like copper.

pipe_height.description: Optional, chimney: instead, how far the stove pipes stand above the roof, in metres, like 1.5.

pipes.description: Optional, chimney: instead of the chimney, how many stove pipes come out through the roof.

pitch.description: roof: how steep, in degrees, like 40.

porch_depth.description: Optional, porch: how deep, in tiles, like 2. Left out, as it is, or 1.5.

room.description: floor: the room, like living or kitchen (house names them).

shade.description: paint: a colour as you'd say it (moss, dusty rose) or a #hex; a room's walls also take a material (plaster, zellige).

size.description: Optional, paint with design: how wide it is, in metres, like 2. Left out, a size to suit the surface.

tiled.description: Optional, paint with design: true repeats it as a pattern over the surface. Left out, once, in the middle.

what.description: paint: a part (door, siding, trim, roof, shutters, porch …), a room (kitchen), a thing at home (sofa), or outside with like.

x.description: room: x of its corner, in tiles.

z.description: room: z of its corner, in tiles.

name: home
title: Change the home
